offer.text: I wandered too far and now the sun's nearly gone. I can find the way myself if you'll keep the monsters off me — walk with me to the nearest village before something finds us.

accept.text: Bless you. I'll lead — you just keep your blade between me and the dark.

decline.text: Then I'll have to chance the road alone. Pray for me.

in_progress.text: Stay close behind me — I daren't run.

ready.text: Walls and torchlight at last! We made it.

complete.text: I'd have died out there without you. I won't forget this.

failed.text: They caught us on the road... I barely escaped. Leave me be a while.
